column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each water/waste management record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), associating water/waste data with equipment.
A REAL value showing the current water tank level percentage.
A DECIMAL(7,2) indicating water pressure in kilopascals.
A FLOAT representing the water temperature in Celsius.
A NUMERIC(8,3) specifying water flow rate in liters per minute.
An INT rating or index representing overall water quality (e.g., 0–100 scale).
A DECIMAL(5,2) measuring how full the waste tank is as a percentage of capacity.
